rooms.name: Fortified Fringe
rooms.desc:
To your west and south the sea clashes with the sturdy walls of the
domed structure.  Centered on the surface of the massive structure is a
bubblelike formation.  Within the center you can vaguely make out what
looks to be a porthole, but there is no opening on the dome here.

rooms.name: Fortified Fringe
rooms.desc:
Raging waves pound into the ledge, creating a salty cloud of mist
that permeates the air. To your east is a spherical entryway, though
you cannot get in through this point. Through the walls you notice
a dark opening, yet it seems you must walk around to the front before
you can enter.

rooms.name: Fortified Fringe
rooms.desc:
You stand on the surrounding ledge of a massive structure that rises
from the depths of the ocean. To the southeast is a domed, transparent
entryway that juts out from the core of the encompassing, solid margin.
Peering through the walls you can see a small porthole, though you
cannot enter the sphere here.

rooms.name: Fortified Fringe
rooms.desc:
To the south is what looks to be an impenetrable bubble. However,
by looking through the transparent walls of the dome, you can see that
the entryway is on the opposite side.

rooms.name: Fortified Fringe
rooms.desc:
The ocean is a bit calmer here on the northeast corner than it
was to the south, though you are still unable to hear yourself speak.
Southwest from here is what seems to be a domelike formation that may
be the entryway to the dense, underwater structure.

rooms.name: Fortified Fringe
rooms.desc:
You're relieved to find yourself on the surface of a sturdy
structure that rises from the sea. Thin strips of kelp are scattered
about the surface, making movement tedious.

rooms.name: Fortified Fringe
rooms.desc:
You're standing on the southeast corner of what seems to be the
surface of an underwater structure. Within the center of the surface
is a transparent, global formation. Barnacles are strewn about the
surface along with slick seaweed.

rooms.name: Fortified Fringe
rooms.desc:
The hemispherical entryway is transparent, and within you can see a 
dark outlet descending into the heart of the structure. The entropic
sea to the south creates such a loud uproar that all other sounds are
silenced.

rooms.name: Inside the Dome
rooms.desc:
The walls are amazingly airtight and soundproof. Thus, the blaring
sounds of the sea fade out, allowing you to hear some of the strange,
echoing sounds that come from below.

rooms.name: Conduit
rooms.desc:
While descending you hear what sounds like someone breathing in the
shadows below, though you're not sure if you're hearing things or not.

rooms.name: Conduit
rooms.desc:
An eerie, distorted moan comes from below and reverberates
throughout the conduit. Your depth of sight is limited to the small
sphere of illumination from your light-source.

rooms.name: Conduit
rooms.desc:
Barnacles tear at your hands and feet as you carefully nudge
yourself downwards. The lower you descend, the more humid the air gets,
making it difficult to breathe.

rooms.name: Conduit
rooms.desc:
A sharp scent of fish comes from below, and for the first time you
can see shimmering light below. The soothing, oscillatory sound of water
emanates all around you, reminding you that you're UNDER water in this
strange structure.

rooms.name: Underwater Concavity
rooms.desc:
This massive cavity seems to be designed such that each segment of
wall is supported by the other, and the only added reinforcement is
water-pressure. There is no other material in this room that adds
support, making the whole design ingenious. The material is unusual,
for it seems strong, yet it's transparent like a cut diamond. The whole
effect is rather peculiar. It's as if you're submerged in water without
feeling any liquid. Arched, transparent passageways lead off in all
directions.

rooms.name: Transparent Passage
rooms.desc:
A soft glow seems to come from the seafloor that illuminates everything 
faintly. Schools of fish swim below, and to your right is a flat bed of
coral. Sea creatures encircle the whole chamber, which makes you feel 
uneasy.

rooms.name: Transparent Passage
rooms.desc:
A massive shark cruises above the channel, creating a reverberative
gushing noise and a slight swaying of the passage. The pressure from the
water could shatter the passage and drown you instantly, though whoever
or whatever build this seems confident in its design, so you should be
too--right?

rooms.name: Transparent Passage
High-pressured Chamber
rooms.desc:
You hear a slight ringing in your ears due to the extreme pressure in
this chamber. The whole room is like a hollowed out globe, with the lower
half submerged in the seafloor and the upper exposed to the waters. The
seafloor glows bright orange, making the chamber feel like a burning
sphere of light.

rooms.name: Northeast of a Pressured-chamber
rooms.desc:
To your west you can see the entrence, and southwest from here is a
thin ladder that protrudes from the top of the globe, allowing one to
climb into an upper chamber. It's difficult to stand here, for the walls
slope upward due to the spherical interior of this chamber.

rooms.name: Within a Pressured-chamber
rooms.desc:
Due to the sharply angled walls it's difficult to stabilize your 
stance. To the west you can see a thick substance that drips from
the axis of the global chamber. It leads up into an upper loft, which 
seems to serve as some sort of observatory. Your clothes are illuminated
by the glowing seafloor, making you light up like a firefly.

rooms.name: Southeast of a Pressured-chamber
rooms.desc:
You stand in the southeast area of a global chamber, and to your west
and north is the ladder-like substance that leads upwards into another
joint-formation. You marvel at the carfully placed blocks of transparent
walling. Each are cut flawlessly so that no other supporting material is
needed.

rooms.name: Within a Pressured-chamber
rooms.desc:
Aside from the humidity and the unbearable pressure, the ambiance
is otherworldly: nudged against the translucent walls are patches of 
multicolored coral and, almost hidden below, lies purple, gray, and orange
starfish. What makes the scene so extraordinary is that you feel as if
you're completly surrounded by water, and for a moment you forget that
the walls are there.

rooms.name: Southwest of a Pressured-chamber
rooms.desc:
Pure silence overtakes you, making you feel uneasy. You glance up
through the crystalline ceiling, only to notice a small shadow move 
slowly from one side of the chamber to the other, then make a sharp turn 
in your direction. Is it outside or inside? You can't tell, but either way
it senses your presence.

rooms.name: Within a Pressured-chamber
rooms.desc:
The walls here slope upwards, making it difficult to stand without 
using your hands for support. Looking out of the walls to the west you
see that a school of jellyfish gliding by. Light from the glowing seafloor
reflects within the translucent fish, making them appear as if they
glowed internally.

rooms.name: Northwest of a Pressured-chamber
rooms.desc:
You notice how, for some reason, the seafloor glows fainter here than 
any of the other positions within the spherical chamber. Then, suddenly, 
an anomalous, crablike creature glides across the seafloor and burrows 
underneath the chamber. Glowing streaks of gelatinous substance ooze from
the creatures mouth, which fuses with the seafloor, causing it to brighten
considerably.

rooms.name: Underneath the Observatory
rooms.desc:
A grooved, thick substance extrudes from what seems to be a formation
attached to the exterior of the sphere. It seems that the ruts in the
material function as grips, allowing one to climb easily above. For a 
moment the entire chamber is darkened. Looking up, you notice an abnormally
wide manta ray that sails by sluggishly.

rooms.name: Observatory
rooms.desc:
You shuffle around in the dark until you nudge what feels to be a lever.
Upon doing so, an illuminated liquid flows out from a bladder within the 
interior of the transparent walls. Gradually, the glowing liquid flows out 
and covers the shell of the observatory, lighting the entire area. The walls
in this area seem to magnify everything outside, amplifying your sense-
perception.

rooms.name: Tubular Pass
rooms.desc:
Gradually, the pasage descends underneath the seafloor's surface, making
the transparent walls encased with soft earth. You can see fluorescent liquid
flow through small veins through the glass-like tubing, which reveals a
labyrinth of hydraulic networks--twisting and winding about--providing light
for an otherwise dark passage.

rooms.name: Tubular Pass
rooms.desc:
Much like a tree's manifold branches that, when growing, sprout out in a
random fashion, the veins of glowing liquid spread out and intertwine,
illuminating the pass. An overwhelming sensation of wonder resinates within
this pass, and for a moment you loose track of where you are.

rooms.name: Tubular Pass
rooms.desc:
The underground network of fluorescent liquid must originate from somewhere
within the core of the structure, and from that point it flows throughout the
areas which require lighting. The complexity of this infrastructure fills you
with awe, though you doubt the creatures that live here would care for your
admiration.

rooms.name: Junction
rooms.desc:
There's a split here that resembles a 'v', allowing one to travel more
east or west depending on which direction is chosen. The luminous liquid
flows quickly through the veins, much like the branching system of muscular
tubes that carry blood away from the heart to the organs of the body.

rooms.name: Underground Passage
rooms.desc:
The material used for the walls is no longer transparent, though every few
meters there is a small, organic bulb that drops from the ceiling. The bulb is
filled with swirling, illuminating liquid, making a cone of light extend from
the ceiling that creates a circular patch of lit flooring.

rooms.name: Underground Passage
rooms.desc:
Cold vapors flow from underneath a thin slit on the ground to the north,
thereby revealing a virtually hidden door. You reach out and touch the cold,
organic surface of the door, searching for a handle, but find nothing. Almost
hidden on the east wall is a thin slot, and from this you realize that you
require some kind of key to enter.

rooms.name: Hatchery
rooms.desc:
The temperature of this room is frigid, and there is no light source.
White vapors flow fourth from the periphery of the ceiling onto the floor
like liquid, carpeting everything with a thin layer of fog. Hundreds of
thin trays align the walls, and within the trays are thousands of small,
pearl-like eggs. From each corner there are small tubes that feed water
into the trays which, in turn, creates a constant gurgling noise.

rooms.name: Underground Passage
rooms.desc:
In the distance you can hear what sounds like leaves rustling in a violent
wind; however, upon moving closer, you make out thousands of glimmering
shells moving about on the ground, clacking into each other as they skitter
about. Once amidst the activity, the shellcrabs stop and hide within their
shells for protection.

rooms.name: Underground Passage
rooms.desc:
The bulbs that extend from the ceiling resemble those found on kelp, yet
these bulbs are much larger and seem to be grafted onto the ceiling. Light
pulsates slowly, and every few minutes the passage becomes opaque. To the
north is what appears to be a door. It's hard to tell due to the vine-like
growth that covers it.

rooms.name: Repository
rooms.desc:
Hollowed compartments extend from the floor to the ceiling on every wall.
Green-tinted film covers some of the compartments, creating an airtight seal
to preserve their contents. Upon touch, the film quickly disperses away from
where you placed your finger, much like ripples in a pond moving away from
whatever ruptures the surface.

rooms.name: Translucent Channel
rooms.desc:
This conduit is slightly narrower than the others, forcing you to bend
uncomfortably as you walk. Also, unlike the other passages, this channel 
seems to descend slightly, gradually submerging into the seafloor.

rooms.name: Translucent Channel
rooms.desc:
To your west, at the end of the channel, you see an undulatory, orange
light. The entire channel slowly phases from darkness to an orange haze,
then back to darkness, making your walk precarious.

rooms.name: Covered Channel
rooms.desc:
Only a small transparent space remains at the apex of the arced ceiling,
making the channel seem more like an underground tunnel. Below you see only
dirtlike substance with stringy burrows twisting about, marking the existence
of some kind of ocean dwelling worm.

rooms.name: Brachyuraian Hive
rooms.desc:
Thousands of miniature crablike creatures are scattered about the chamber,
some half burried in crevices, others skittering about, transporting food and
material from above to create and sustain their hive. They don't seem to notice
you, and continue with their reproductive process.

rooms.name: Northeast within the Hive
rooms.desc:
The entire chamber ebbs with an orange light that emanates from within the
shells of the crablike creatures. They cling and traverse the ceiling as well
as the floor, making the entire cavern move as if it were alive. The creatures
seem to be familiar with interacting with humanoids, or humanlike beings, for
they go about their duties without taking notice to your presence.

rooms.name: Southeast within the Hive
rooms.desc:
Being carful not to step on any of the creatures, you painstakingly edge
your way to the southeast corner of the Hive. The walls and ground are damp 
and claylike, making it easy for the crablike creatures to burrow within the 
walls for the use of storage and reproduction. Small piles of kelp are
heaped in the corner here, proabably used as a food source.

rooms.name: Within the Hive
rooms.desc:
It seems that these creatures are being bred for the sole purpose of
reproducing the glowing substance they produce naturally, for this substance
can be used as a natural light source. A self-sufficient creature that can
secrete such a substance is fascinating, though the other beings who have
also discovered this would not appreciate you leaving with this discovery.

rooms.name: Southwest within the Hive
rooms.desc:
Scurrying about everywhere are young crablike creatures. Some carry in
kelp, while others scape the walls and burrow holes for housing. Each creature
seems to have a specific duty that is carried out efficiently. For the first
time you notice some of the larger--perhaps female--creatures half burrowed
within the wall to the left.

rooms.name: Within the Hive
rooms.desc:
Stockpiles of kelp are stuffed into gaping holes in the wall to the left,
providing nourishment to the larger creatures which seem to be bound to the 
wall. You assume that these larger creatures are the females, and are situated
in this fixed fashion due to their reproductive duties.

rooms.name: Northwest within the Hive
rooms.desc:
To your left is a female crab embedded within the wall, and, for a short
moment, it wiggles left and right until it dislodges itself. What is left 
behind is the rear section of its body, and dozens of newly-born creatures
scatter out from the rump, leaving only an empty shell that will be recycled
and used as food or building material.

rooms.name: Within the Hive
rooms.desc:
Infant crabs align all sections of the wall to the north, and when the
pulsating glow fades it looks as if the wall is alive. A profusion of crabs
pour out from a hole in the ceiling, and soon after they quickly seal it.
These creatures' disgusting habitat and mode of living is repulsive, and for
a moment you become nauseated with the overwhelming stimulus of their life-
sustaining activities.

rooms.name: Center of the Hive
rooms.desc:
It seems as if the creatures avoid walking within the midst of their
breeding grounds, for there is an invisible symmetric circle that they
avoid crossing, leaving a bare patch of earth beneath your feet. There is
no obvious explanation for the purpose of avoiding the center, though there
must be some reason they do not cross here. Then, around the fringes of the
circle, you notice a carcass from one of the crabs and you see many skeletal
remains from these creatures scattered about beneath your feet.

rooms.name: Underwater Walkway
rooms.desc:
Transparent material is used for the tubed passage, thus, you are able
to see in all directions, including below, for the tubing is elevated about
one meter from the seafloor.

rooms.name: Underwater Walkway
rooms.desc:
For the first time you notice thin strands that fasten to the exterior of
the walkway and extend upwards at an angle. You assume these cables are used
as support for this elevated walkway, and must connect to the solid block
from which you entered.

rooms.name: Underwater Walkway
rooms.desc:
The angle that you must ascend increases dramatically, and the whole
walkway is lifted even higher from the seafloor, almost to the point where
it's no longer visible. The water is darker here, making it difficult to see
with any depth, though you catch sight of a few fish when they swim close to
the tubing.

rooms.name: Hibernation Chamber
rooms.desc:
Aligning the perimeter of this cylindrical, hovering chamber, is a thin
rim that appears to be used for hibernation. Glancing upwards, you realize
that the elevation of this cylinder is much greater than expected. There
must be similar hibernation quarters above, accessible by the three ladder-
like beams that are located in front and on the sides of the chamber.

rooms.name: Northwest corner
rooms.desc:
Resting on the rim to your west and north is a layer of peculiar
insulating material. You assume that the temperature of the waters drop
at times, and thus whatever sleeps here must require extra warmth to avoid
hypothermic condtions. This seems strange, however, for the humidity would
lead one to belive it's warm all year round. Perhaps the moisture comes
from somewhere else.

rooms.name: Hibernation Chamber
rooms.desc:
An awkward, organic ladder leaders upwards through a porthole, and to
the south is a thick tube of transparent material that functions as a
brace within the center of the complex. Because of this, one can glance
through the center beam, allowing partial visibility through to the other
side.

rooms.name: Northeast Corner
rooms.desc:
A thin veneer of glowing substance is used to align the outer rim of the
bunking, creating a guiding strip of light around the border of the chamber.
The light source is faint, allowing one to espy vague figurations, though
nothing completely distinguishable.

rooms.name: Hibernation Chamber
rooms.desc:
From a porthole in the upper loft, a thick, organic ladder stretches to
the floor. When placing your hand on the organic substance, it slowly bends
about your hand, providing a strong grasp for climbing. Eerie light ebbs in
and out, and for a moment everything is visible. Then suddenly, the light
dissipates, leaving you motionless in darkness.

rooms.name: Southeast Corner
rooms.desc:
Moisture has condensed on the ceiling and walls, leaving a thick blanket
of dampness. Every few minutes the moisture builds up on the ceiling, leaving
glistening droplets that await a minor disturbance to make them fall and
splatter. The droning sound of the droplets dislodging and falling to the
ground could potentially drive one insane.

rooms.name: Hibernation Chamber
rooms.desc:
Vague silhouettes dance about on the other side of the transparent beam.
You cannot tell if they are alive, or whether they are nothing more than
reflections from the waters outside. Ether way, the effect makes you grow
more anxious, more tense. Whatever would call this place home is surely
mad.

rooms.name: Southwest Corner
rooms.desc:
Tediously repetitious sounds of liquid falling from the ceiling becomes
increasingly annoying, making you grit your teeth with tension. You wonder
how, due to the lack of heat within this chamber, there is so much humidity.
There must be another source that creates this moisture. To the northwest you
can see the entrance, and east from here is a strange, organic ladder that
allows access to the upper level.

rooms.name: Upper Level
rooms.desc:
Another thin bunk encircles the upper loft, allowing more space for
hibernating. There is a large bundle of insulating material resting on the
bunk here, and it looks as if something or someone could be underneath it.

rooms.name: Hibernator
rooms.desc:
From this point, you can see a red, glowing ring at the peak of the
center-beam. You look closer and notice that it is a heat source, and
the water within the center of the beam is boiling. Small holes in the
beam open up, venting steam into the chamber. This must be used to
maintain a constant climate for proper sleeping conditions.

rooms.name: Upper Level
rooms.desc:
Pulsating light from the surrounding bunk creates a bizzare ambiance, and
at once your face is flushed with anxiety. You hear a faint humming coming
from somewhere within this chamber, though you cannot make out the source.

rooms.name: Hibernator
rooms.desc:
Small vent holes open on the surface of the beam, spraying a fine cloud
of mist into the air. This is the source of the humidity, and its function
must be climate-control for hibernation. You notice that the water within
the beam is bubbling, and when you touch the surface, you realize that it's
extremely hot.

rooms.name: Upper Level
rooms.desc:
To the north through the transparent beam you can make out a looming,
dark figure. You quickly become still and stare at it, waiting for signs
of movement to see if it's alive. After blinking, it's gone.

rooms.name: Hibernator
rooms.desc:
Above, at the top of the center-beam, you can see that the rim is 
glowing red-hot. In turn, this heats the seawater within the center of
the beam, and through small vents steam is released into the air, creating
a controlled climate.

rooms.name: Hibernator
rooms.desc:
Steam vents from small holes on the wall to your east, and the glowing
veneer on the rim of the bunk pulsates. Glassy reflections move about on the
walls, and you wonder if they're coming from you or something else.

rooms.name: Hibernator
rooms.desc:
It's extremely hot and humid here, for above you on the outside of the
structure is a red-hot circlet that heats the water within the center-beam.
Through the ceiling here you can make out the surface of the ocean, and to
your left through the walls you can see the solid structure from which you
came.

rooms.name: A Lagoon
rooms.desc:
The opening in the crags to the east has allowed the formation of this
small, shallow lagoon.  Like liquid within a bowl, the crags lagoon the
water in all directions, leaving the waters fairly calm aside from a few 
humps that roll across the waters from waves that manage to break through
the small opening to the east.

rooms.name: A Lagoon
rooms.desc:
South of here are towering jagged cliffs that lean out over the lagoon,
casting a shadow over the waters. Small swells ripple through the opening 
to the east, though the water remains calm enough to traverse comfortably. 
When compared to the ocean, the lagoon is clear and relatively shallow,
making a wonderful habitat for exotic fish.

rooms.name: A Lagoon
rooms.desc:
The water feels like a warm-springs due to the tropical climate, and 
because of the encompassing crags, the water remains calm and clear, 
allowing you to see through the surface. Purple sea-cucumbers and wispy 
urchins clad the lagoon's floor. West of here is a sandy inlet that 
extends out from the base of the craggs to the north and south.

rooms.name: A Lagoon
rooms.desc:
There's an abundance of beautiful fish, including harmless sand-sharks, 
that glide about within the clear lagoon. You see a thin, white fish with 
yellow bands and silky threaded fins dart underneath some rocks on the 
lagoon's floor as you pass. To the west is a black-sand beach that 
stretches across to each crags' base.

rooms.name: A Sandy Shore
rooms.desc:
In the distance to your north and south, you see towering black cliffs 
that form a small lagoon to the east. The cliffs provide shelter from the 
raging waters, and have allowed the formation of this sandy inlet. Pale 
water surges onto the shore after each breaking wave, leaving white film 
behind at the contour of its reach. The sand is opaque, which in turn 
absorbs the heat from the sun, making your feet noticeably warmer. To your 
west is a thick, topical jungle.

rooms.name: A Sandy Shore
rooms.desc:
Black cliffs rise out of the sand to the north, and curve out to the 
east like a demon's horn. The tide swells inland, then quickly rolls back 
into the small lagoon to the east. A tropical jungle outlines the beach to 
your west that, upon further notice, appears to have been trimmed somewhat. 
Slash marks cover the palms, and whole bushels of various plant life have 
been mutilated, allowing a crude passage.

rooms.name: A Sandy Shore
rooms.desc:
To your east a calm lagoon has been formed by the island's cradling 
rock formation, and outstretched here at the shore of the lagoon is a 
small black-sand beach. West of here, outlining the beach, is a thick 
tropical jungle. Glancing further west you can see the cliffs circle 
around the fringes of the jungle in the form of a circle. From this 
observation you realize that the only way into the heart of the isle 
is through the small opening into the lagoon.

rooms.name: A Sandy Shore
rooms.desc:
Dark cliffs hang over the cove to the south and curl out to the east, 
forming a small lagoon. The cliffs prevent any significant ocean activity, 
allowed the formation of this small, sandy inlet. After walking about for 
a bit, you notice your footprints on the sand's surface, and while doing 
so become aware of others--others that, when observed closely, look to be 
fresly made. However, these prints are not your own. The prints recede into 
a lush jungle to your west.

rooms.name: A Lush Jungle
rooms.desc:
If it were not for the preclearing of paths through the jungle, moving 
about would be impossible due to the thickness of the plant life. Narrow 
trails lead off to the west and south, and to the north the isle's crags 
rise high above the tropical trees.

rooms.name: A Lush Jungle
rooms.desc:
Ferns, palms, sugar cane, guava trees, and hundreds of other exotic 
plant life imbue the entire area. However, every so often you notice some
sort of deformity in the foliage, as if caused by a clash between unknown
forces, tearing at each other and, in turn, destroying the environment.

rooms.name: A Lush Jungle
rooms.desc:
Constant chirping from strange birds and tree-animals almost drowns out
the hacking noise in the distance: a steady, repetitive chopping, much
like the noise one makes when clearing a path in the forest. Bamboo shoots 
are skattered about here, and a delicate mango tree has sprouted up within 
the center of the area.

rooms.name: A Lush Jungle
rooms.desc:
South of here the cliffs curve around and continue back into the jungle. 
You can hear the lapping of the lagoon's waters to the east, and also a faint
hacking noise in the distance to your west. The humidity here makes your 
breathing difficult, and holding onto your weapon becomes increasingly 
challenging with a damp grip.

rooms.name: A Lush Jungle
rooms.desc:
The crags block passage to the north and east, and continue to stretch 
out to your west. A strange symbol has been carved into the wall of the 
north crag that seems to be placed as a territorial mark indicating the
perceived ownership of the isle. Clearings have been made to your west and 
south.

rooms.name: A Lush Jungle
rooms.desc:
A large tropical tree juts out of the earth here, and covering its trunk
are thousands of intertwined roots that twist about to the trunks. You see 
some monkeys springing from one branch to the next above you, and to the 
north a bit is a patch of rubber trees and bamboo.

rooms.name: A Lush Jungle
rooms.desc:
On the ground are a few empty coconut shells that have been crudely 
bashed open. A patch of sugar cane has been partially chopped down behind 
you as well, leaving the ground skattered with chunks of cane and leaves.
The sound of birds chirping fills the air, and all you can see is jungle
in every direction.

rooms.name: A lush Jungle
rooms.desc:
A boar's hide has been strung up on a tree here to dry along with some
kelp. To the east you can make out a small clearing, and thin paths are 
torn through the jungle in every other direction. A few ant beds rise up
from the ground, and you realize that you've been treading over a bed of 
ants the whole while.

rooms.name: A Lush Jungle
rooms.desc:
You notice a large, unset snare resting in the center of the trail 
here. You admire the craftmenship of the snare until, after looking up, you 
realize its full intention: the snare is designed to fling an animal--or 
human--into a bed of sharpened stakes that are fastened to a tree above 
your head.

rooms.name: A lush Jungle
rooms.desc:
Black cliffs rise up to the south and are angled such that they jut
out over the jungle a bit, casting shadows along its base. A strange 
symbol has been carved on the cliff's wall to the south that must may
be some sort of territorial marking.

rooms.name: Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Various fruit trees hang low enough for one to pluck the offerings
without stretching. Ferns and moss covered rocks cover the ground, 
making everything seem as if it were painted with a dark green. The 
island's crags rise up to the north and curve around to the west, 
allowing passage to the east and south.

rooms.name: Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Hundreds of birds inhabit the tree here, making you cringe from the 
sound of their constant chatter. Small felines skatter upon sensing your
presence, as if conditioned to be hypersensitive to potential danger.
The trails taper off here, making passage difficult, though you manage
to cut yourself a path wherever you please, except west, where a large
boulder blocks your path.

rooms.name: A Jungle Clearing
rooms.desc:
Fastened between two palms is a bench, and a braided roap made out 
of kelp has been strung across further up the palms to hold bags of 
food off of the ground and out of reach of animals. A fire pit has also 
been constructed out of large shards of black rock. Palm leaves are 
resting upon wooden beams that are secured on various trees, forming 
sturdy roofing designed to keep the area dry during rains.

rooms.name: Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
A faint buzzing noise comes from the south, and narrow trails have 
been carved into the jungle in almost every direction. You can see the
sky for the first time here through a small opening in the tropical 
trees. Arrrg! The mosquitoes are driving you mad! You decide to move
on before they eat you alive.

rooms.name: Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
A bright, multicolored bird rests at the base of a trunk here that 
quickly flutters away when you get too close. A wasp hive has been 
plastered to the base of a palm here, and swarms of wasps buzz in and 
out of the hive, paying no attention to your presence.

rooms.name: Dense Jungle
rooms.desc:
Cliffs continue to encircle the jungle, halting passage to the south.
The surrounding jungle seems to be left undisturbed compared to the rest 
of the island, making you feel more alone and at ease. Somewhere to the 
northeast you hear a cacophony of birds chattering and chirping.
